detections.evidence_quote: they engineered food to be more addictive
detections.summary: Claims the food industry engineered refined flour and carbohydrates to be addictive, stripping nutrients and adding chemicals while marketing it as 'enriched.'

detections.evidence_quote: they were laughing at the public because they were taking things like whole wheat and converting it
detections.summary: Portrays the food industry as deliberately deceiving the public through engineered food products.

detections.evidence_quote: Is increasing your body's insulin level, and that is probably one of the root causes of so many chronic diseases.
detections.summary: Claims refined flour raises insulin levels, a root cause of chronic disease and precursor to diabetes.

detections.evidence_quote: that is probably one of the root causes of so many chronic diseases
detections.summary: Frames rising insulin from refined flour as a root cause of many chronic diseases.

detections.evidence_quote: Pesticides have estrogen-like binding properties
detections.summary: Claims pesticides have estrogen-like binding properties and have been banned in other countries.

detections.evidence_quote: sperm counts are half of what they were just 50 years ago
detections.summary: Claims pesticides may explain sperm counts being half of what they were 50 years ago and decreasing fertility.

detections.evidence_quote: the earliest age of puberty of any developed country in the world
detections.summary: Claims the age of puberty has decreased to 10-13 in the US, the earliest of any developed country, attributing it to pesticides affecting children's hormones.

detections.evidence_quote: the five plus billion gallons of pesticides we pour on crops is making its way into the food supply and affecting the hormones of young children
detections.summary: Frames pesticide exposure as a driver of declining fertility and earlier puberty, in a chronic-disease-and-environment narrative.

detections.evidence_quote: in the past, we would only talk about these topics in our doctors' lounges
detections.summary: Says these health topics were previously confined to doctors' lounges and conferences, and a group of physicians is now taking them directly to the public.

detections.evidence_quote: there are these giant blind spots in medicine, things we're not talking about
detections.summary: Frames mainstream medicine as having blind spots and unaddressed topics.

detections.evidence_quote: half of our nation's children are overweight or obese
detections.summary: Claims half of American children are overweight or obese and nearly a quarter have high insulin or pre-diabetes, versus 3% in Japan.

detections.evidence_quote: we have been poisoning the food supply, and we've only been taking a medication-based approach
detections.summary: Attributes childhood metabolic problems to a poisoned food supply and an overmedicated, medication-based healthcare approach rather than children's behavior.

detections.evidence_quote: we have been poisoning the food supply
detections.summary: Alleges the food supply has been poisoned.

detections.evidence_quote: What are the root causes of these chronic diseases?
detections.summary: Calls for identifying root causes of chronic disease rather than treating symptoms with medication.

detections.evidence_quote: I encourage everybody to eat only organic food, especially when you're eating the peel
detections.summary: Recommends eating organic food, especially for produce where the peel is eaten, and getting back to whole foods.

detections.evidence_quote: we need to get back to whole foods
detections.summary: Recommends organic and whole foods on the grounds of being more natural.

detections.evidence_quote: Do you do you take a probiotic for your gut microbiome?
detections.summary: Asks whether the guest takes a probiotic for gut microbiome health.

detections.evidence_quote: ten to twenty percent of the average American's calorie intake comes from seed oil derivatives
detections.summary: Claims seed oils like sunflower, canola and soybean/corn oil make up 10-20% of average American calorie intake, are cheap and government-subsidized, and are chemically produced despite sounding natural.

detections.evidence_quote: They sound natural, but they're not.
detections.summary: Condemns seed oils for sounding natural while being chemically manufactured and not occurring in nature.

detections.evidence_quote: the gut is the front line of defense from allergens and exposures
detections.summary: Explains the GI tract lining as an immune system front line of defense against allergens and rejected substances.

detections.evidence_quote: These are oils that don't denature at high temperatures
detections.summary: Recommends extra virgin olive oil, coconut oil and avocado oil as healthy because they aren't chemically denatured at high temperatures during production.

detections.evidence_quote: the benefits of replacing those hormones, what we call hormone replacement therapy, are tremendous
detections.summary: Argues hormone replacement therapy for postmenopausal women is underused despite tremendous benefits in relieving menopause symptoms like hot flashes, night sweats, mood swings and weight gain.

detections.evidence_quote: One of the big blind spots in modern medicine has been the underuse of hormone replacement
detections.summary: Frames mainstream medicine's underuse of hormone replacement therapy as one of its 'blind spots.'
